h1: The 6 Best Wireless Ergonomic Keyboard and Mouse Combos of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Wireless Ergonomic Combos: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six wireless ergonomic keyboard and mouse combos, wave, vertical and quiet designs, with picks by budget and desk setup.
mainKeyword: wireless ergonomic keyboard and mouse combos
summary: The Logitech Wave Keys and Lift Mouse combo is our best overall pick, pairing a wave keyboard with a vertical mouse. The ProtoArc EKM02 Wave Keys is the budget alternative, the SABLUTE MA41 is the quiet pick, and the SABLUTE rechargeable set suits anyone tired of batteries.
intro: The classic combo mistake is assuming wireless means one dongle for both devices. Several listings in this price range ask you to verify whether the keyboard and mouse share a single receiver or use two, and that decides how many USB ports you lose.

We reviewed six wireless ergonomic keyboard and mouse sets on paper, looking at the keyboard shape, the mouse design, power, noise claims and price bucket. We counted the Logitech Wave Keys and Lift combo once even though it comes in two colours.

products.name: Logitech Wave Keys Keyboard and Lift Mouse Ergonomic Combo - Graphite
products.verdict: A matched wave keyboard and vertical mouse that connect either way.
products.description:
This set pairs the Wave Keys keyboard with the Lift vertical mouse, designed to match. It supports Bluetooth or a receiver, and is sold in the $50 to $100 bucket in graphite, with a rose colourway also offered.

It tops the list because the matching ergonomic design covers both hands, with a vertical mouse that is a genuine posture change. The tradeoff is a higher price than the budget sets below it.

Buy it if you want a proper ergonomic pair from one maker. Check the listing for whether it ships with one dongle or two.
products.idealFor: A full ergonomic upgrade from one brand.

products.name: ProtoArc EKM02 Wave Keys Ergonomic Wireless Keyboard and Mouse, Black
products.verdict: A wave-style wireless combo at a lower price point.
products.description:
The EKM02 is a wireless ergonomic keyboard and mouse set with a wave-style layout, priced in the $50 to $100 bucket at the lower end.

Second place is due to the fact that it offers a similar wave concept to the Logitech set for less. The cost is a less distinctive mouse than a Lift vertical design.

Pick it if you want the wave style on a tighter budget. Verify the dongle arrangement on the page.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers who want a wave layout.

products.name: ProtoArc EKM01 Plus Wireless Ergonomic Keyboard Mouse Combo, Gray Black
products.verdict: A budget friendly wireless ergonomic set from a focused brand.
products.description:
The EKM01 Plus is a wireless ergonomic keyboard and mouse combo sold in the $50 to $100 bucket and described as budget friendly.

Third place is due to the fact that the listing gives fewer design details than the EKM02, though it is similar in price. Both are close for most buyers.

It suits shoppers who want a straightforward ergonomic pair. Verify single or dual dongle first.
products.idealFor: A simple ergonomic upgrade on a budget.

products.name: SABLUTE MA41 Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo, 30dB Quiet Ergonomic
products.verdict: A budget combo that states a 30dB quiet rating.
products.description:
The MA41 is a wireless keyboard and mouse combo with a manufacturer stated 30dB quiet rating, in the $25 to $50 bucket.

Fourth position follows from the fact that the quiet claim comes from the maker rather than an independent source. It is the cheaper alternative to the sets above.

Choose it for shared rooms and calls. Verify the single or dual dongle setup.

products.name: SABLUTE Ergonomic Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo, Rechargeable
products.verdict: A rechargeable ergonomic pair that skips disposable batteries.
products.description:
This SABLUTE set is a rechargeable ergonomic keyboard and mouse combo with a matched design, in the $50 to $100 bucket.

Fifth place is explained by the fact that it costs more than the MA41 without a stated noise rating. The reward is no disposable cells.

Pick it if you dislike buying batteries. Check the dongle arrangement on the listing.
products.idealFor: Anyone who wants a battery free desk.

products.name: Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo, 2.4G Ergonomic Wave Keys, Black
products.verdict: The cheapest wave-style 2.4G combo in this ranking.
products.description:
An unbranded 2.4G set with a wave-shaped keyboard and a matching mouse, and the cheapest entry on this page.

It comes last because the brand gives less to go on than the others. It is the pick when cost matters most.

Buy it as a cheap trial of a wave layout. Verify single or dual dongle first.
products.idealFor: A cheap trial of an ergonomic layout.

whatMatters.detail: Some combos use one receiver for both devices, others use two. Two receivers take up two USB ports, which matters on a laptop. Read the listing carefully, since these listings tell you to verify it.
A vertical mouse turns your hand to a handshake position, easing forearm twist. It takes a few days to learn. Look for the word vertical in the name.
A wave keyboard curves the key rows to match your hand arc. It is gentler than a full split. Check the listing images for the curve.
Rechargeable sets avoid replacing batteries. Look for the word rechargeable in the title.
A decibel figure tells you how loud keys and clicks are. A maker stated number is a claim, not a measurement we verified.

faq.q: Do both devices share one dongle?
faq.a: It varies, and the listings tell you to verify it. Check before ordering if USB ports are scarce.

faq.q: Will a vertical mouse feel odd?
faq.a: Yes for a few days. Give it time before judging.

faq.q: Is the Logitech combo worth it over the ProtoArc EKM02?
faq.a: If you want a vertical mouse and Bluetooth, yes. If you only want a wave layout, the ProtoArc costs less.

faq.q: How do I connect a wireless combo?
faq.a: Plug in the receiver or pair over Bluetooth, then switch both devices on.

faq.q: How do I keep it running?
faq.a: Charge rechargeable sets regularly, and keep the receiver close to the devices.
It is stated by the manufacturer. Treat it as a claim, not an independent measurement.

finalTake: The Logitech Wave Keys and Lift Mouse combo is the best overall set because it matches a wave keyboard with a vertical mouse. The ProtoArc EKM02 is the sensible budget alternative, and the SABLUTE MA41 suits quiet rooms. Always confirm the dongle arrangement before you buy.
